attributes.name: Phoenix Tail
attributes.powers:
When you encounter this card, you may reveal a card that has the Shelyn trait to automatically acquire this card.

Recharge this card to add 1d4+3 to any check by a character at your location.

Bury this card to explore your location. During this exploration, add 1d4+3 to your checks. After playing this card, you may bury a card that has the Shelyn trait to recharge this card instead of burying it.
